title: Number and Profile of Persons who Attempted Suicide
what_it_is: Number and Profile of Persons who Attempted Suicide

sections.label: Elderly suicide trends
sections.summary: No particular trends were picked up for elderly suicide, and no breakdown of living arrangements is available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: In terms of trends, for the elderly specifically, there are no particular trends that we picked up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: It varies from year to year but there is no particular spike in numbers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We do not also have the specific breakdown of the living arrangements of these persons who committed suicide.

sections.label: Suicide causes and prevention
sections.summary: Reasons for suicide are multiple and combined, and the approach is to work with community partners on prevention and support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: It is also, perhaps, a bit simplistic to label the reasons as to why it happens because there are social issues, relationship issues, family issues, mental health issues and sometimes a combination of various factors that causes individuals to take their own lives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We want to work together with community partners, particularly to raise awareness on suicide prevention, encourage distressed persons to seek help, and provide professional support and crisis intervention to at-risk groups.

sections.label: Senior Activity Centres outreach
sections.summary: Senior Activity Centres conduct social activities and home visits to reach elderly living in rental flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: To prevent social isolation and to help us detect risks among seniors early, Senior Activity Centres (SACs) conduct social activities and carry out home visits to reach out to the elderly living in rental flats.

sections.label: Ageing population volume
sections.summary: The number of people ageing is increasing, so the volume itself is increasing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: One, the number of people who are ageing is increasing, so the volume itself is increasing.

sections.label: Befrienders' Programme for elderly
sections.summary: Physical infirmities and self-consciousness in old age may be addressed through regular visitation under the Befrienders' Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Sometimes, when you become older, you have physical infirmities and then you feel self-conscious and, sometimes, it is just a question of perhaps regular visitation and that is something that we are looking at through the Befrienders' Programme, which is why I would urge Members to grow these grassroots activities, whether from the neighbours, the grassroots organisations, volunteers and, in fact, working with corporates.

sections.label: Befriending visits and ageing profile
sections.summary: Regular befriending visits are urged, and MSF is asked to consider working with MOH on Pioneer Generation Ambassadors as befrienders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: But, actually, low-key, simple, weekly, fortnightly befriending visitation goes a very long way and that becomes a bridge to the other activities that we have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: It is something we need to pay attention to because we all know the ageing profile is changing, the numbers will expand, and it behooves us to put in the effort today, so that by the time we reach that stage in 10, 15 years' time when the numbers are quite phenomenal, we can have an environment where we may live long, but I think we can age well, both as individuals and as a community as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Even here, in this House, all of us, as Members of Parliament, elected or otherwise, can do something about it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We can visit them regularly at home with our volunteers and not just wait for grassroots events or the Government to do something about it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) consider working with the Ministry of Health (MOH) to look at how our Pioneer Generation (PG) Ambassadors can also be that first line of befrienders to visit our elderly, because they are already out there and are already trained?

sections.label: Pooling information for targeted befriending
sections.summary: Information gathered at ambassador or grassroots level is pooled to direct befriending efforts more targeted and effectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: What we are trying to do, now that the information is being picked up, whether at the PG Ambassador level or the grassroots level, is decide how we then pool the information together so that we can then direct efforts at befriending in a lot more targeted and effective manner.

sections.label: More dialect programmes and advertisements
sections.summary: The Member will notice there are a lot more dialect programmes and advertisements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Indeed, the Member will notice we have a lot more dialect programmes and advertisements.

sections.label: Befriending outreach beyond English
sections.summary: Outreach for befriending is not just in English.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In terms of the outreach for befriending, it is not just in English.

sections.label: Sourcing speakers and stepping up collaterals
sections.summary: When an elderly person cannot communicate beyond a particular language, someone who speaks it is sourced, and video collaterals are stepped up with producers and directors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: When that happens and we find that some elderly person is not able to communicate beyond a particular language, we will then source for someone who is able to speak the language to come in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In terms of collaterals, such as videos, we are stepping up the effort, working with different producers, directors, to generate some of the materials.
